name: robot-radio-infinity
description: A reactive AI radio station that generates and presents every track live for one listener.

scripts.dev:hosted:google: npm run build:google && npm run start:google
scripts.build:eleven: pnpm --filter @robot-radio/eleven-shared build && pnpm --filter @robot-radio/eleven-web build && pnpm --filter @robot-radio/eleven-server build
scripts.build:google: npm run build --workspace=@robot-radio/google-shared && npm run build --workspace=@robot-radio/google-web && npm run build --workspace=@robot-radio/google-server
scripts.test:google: npm run test --workspace=@robot-radio/google-shared --if-present && npm run test --workspace=@robot-radio/google-server --if-present && npm run test --workspace=@robot-radio/google-web --if-present
scripts.typecheck:eleven: pnpm --filter @robot-radio/eleven-shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @robot-radio/eleven-server typecheck && pnpm --filter @robot-radio/eleven-web typecheck
scripts.typecheck:google: npm run typecheck --workspace=@robot-radio/google-shared --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=@robot-radio/google-server --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=@robot-radio/google-web --if-present
scripts.verify: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build
scripts.verify:all: pnpm test:all && pnpm typecheck:all && pnpm build:all
